- **Gender:** male (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Change P49](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0049), [v3 ch.Davy P16](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0016), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P10](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Milty Boulter is taller and longer in frame than [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). However, he is less broad in build.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001)_

## History

Milty Boulter was a pupil at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school who had already attended for a year before [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) started. During a violent storm that hit [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), his family's unsightly old house burned down, providing solace to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) amidst the storm's broader devastation. He later faced the sorrow of losing his teacher when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resigned her position to attend college.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P54](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0054), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), +3 more_

## Relationships

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--milty-boulter.md)

Milty Boulter is a friend and rival of [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md). Their companionship includes going fishing together, while their rivalry manifests in competing with each other over their height.
